theater: Global — national commands and selected formations
disclosure: A proving set under construction, not a conflict picture. Every record rests on an official defence-ministry or armed-forces page, or on dated public-affairs reporting, chosen because resolution is unambiguous and nothing here is sensitive. Its purpose is to put the decay model under forecast: if a sixty-day half-life on command is calibrated, command-change projections issued at sixty days should resolve near fifty percent. Coordinates are installation or capital centroids, approximate, and denote headquarters rather than any deployed position. Observation dates follow the Spion rule, observed at rather than checked at: where a source page carries no publication date, as_of is the date the page was retrieved. Coverage is deliberately shallow and wide before it is deep: national command first, formations second. COVERAGE NOTE: records with ids beginning F-SEED- are a global skeleton, not knowledge. Their existence claims are SPECULATIVE and they carry no commander. They exist so the shape of what is NOT known is visible on the same board as what is. Filter to DOCUMENTED and above to see only sourced records. PROMOTION 2026-07-30: 189 claims promoted from the compendium spine with provenance carried over; claims arriving past half-life are counted stale on the freshness face rather than hidden — the stale queue is the re-confirmation work queue.
